ACTREC Field Supervisor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Field Supervisor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Field Supervisor. This is a contract-based position within the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Field Supervisor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Field Supervisor post in this recruitment drive by ACTREC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Supervisor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Supervisor position will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Field Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized University and possess a minimum of 2 years of experience as a Health Worker, Field Supervisor, or in related community/public health field activities.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Field Supervisor post is scheduled to be held on 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the location for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at ACTREC, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable). Duly filled application forms may also be required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of ACTREC?
faq.answer: The official website of Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) is www.actrec.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates.
